high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "evergatestables." The post features a photograph of a horse jumping over an obstacle during an equestrian event. The horse, Donvier, is being ridden by a rider dressed in formal equestrian attire, including a black helmet, white breeches, and a dark jacket. The horse is mid-jump, showcasing its athleticism and the skill of the rider. The obstacle consists of colorful, pinwheel-like structures on either side of a striped jump bar.
